How do I use it properly the very first time?

Here’s the best way to use your Endy mattress the very first time: 
Open the box.
Pull the plastics flap to unseal the mattress. Unroll and place on your bed frame or foundation.
Use a pair of scissors to remove the plastic wrap. Cut carefully along the plastic edges, making sure not to damage your mattress cover.
Watch the magic! Your Endy will expand back to its regular size and will be ready to sleep on right away! It will reach perfect comfort in about a week.
If you notice a slight odour after unboxing, allow your mattress to air out for 24 hours, and turn on any fans in the room to increase air circulation.
